Field.Name: TradeReportTransType

Trades that are currently being delayed from publication can be released for immediate publication. Defaults to ‘new’ if unspecified. 0 = New 1 = Cancel 2 = Replace 3 = Release

Should only be set to this value whenusedinconjunctionwith Secondary Trd Type (855)=64(BENC)and Tertiary Trd Type (2896) = 65 (CONT). 65=Package Trade(TPAC)whicharenot Exchangefor Physicals(XFPH),for RTS 2 non-equities only. Insuchscenario,Agency Crosstradesareindicatedbysetting Trd Sub Type (829) = 37. Other values are invalid.
